scope: Three single-call smoke cases only; no shape sweep
version_selection: Newest stable release found in official package index; 9.3.0.beta.1 is a prerelease

cases.name: quant
cases.validation: Exact output and scale bytes for repeated [0,8,64,512] input

cases.name: matmul
cases.validation: Every output versus CPU double accumulation; atol=0.01, rtol=0.005

cases.name: fa
cases.validation: Every attention output versus CPU double softmax(QK/sqrt(D))V; atol=0.002, rtol=0.01

acceptance: Correctness check passes without profiler timeout
Actual selected SoC is an installed 950DT target
Actual kernel identity and A5 binary provenance recorded
Nonempty dynamic instruction records and pipeline timeline for each kernel
Cube events present for matmul and both Cube and Vector events present for FA
Simulator device cycles/time kept distinct from host wall-clock time
notes: Small synthetic cases establish tool functionality, not performance-model accuracy or full-model coverage
Kernel implementation is provided by installed CANN ops, not by smoke host code
